Idle Ping — Proactive Outreach System v1.0.0

- Initial release of a full-featured proactive outreach system.
- Detects user idle status and uses randomized "dice" logic to trigger content delivery.
- Crawls interesting, topic-driven content daily and manages a share queue.
- Sends messages in a configurable persona style if persona files are present.
- Automated setup via install script, including cron jobs for all core components.
- Data and user privacy are ensured by keeping runtime data uncommitted and user-specific.
